title: Voice Assistant Command Log
dataSources: Home Assistant state/logbook events (`homeassistant:event`), Homey flow/insights (`homey:flow`), SmartThings events (`smartthings:event`), Node-RED flow events (`nodered:event`).
app: Home Assistant / Homey / SmartThings / Hubitat / openHAB event streams via MQTT, webhooks, and REST — forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=homeassistant:event event_type=voice_command
| stats count as commands by intent
| sort - commands
| head 20
description: Ranks the voice commands your household actually uses so you can design better automations around real behaviour.
value: Knowing your most-used voice intents reveals which routines to streamline and which fancy automations nobody ever triggers.
implementation: Forward voice-assistant intents to HEC; schedule weekly and review the top commands.
visualization: Bar chart of top voice intents by count.
grandmaExplanation: It lists the voice commands your family uses most, so you can make the popular ones work even better.
